landing.kicker: For buying offices, brands, factories and trading companies
landing.lede: VIA Merch gives each merchandiser an agent that drafts the chasers, status updates and replies they send every day, in each customer's language and format. The merchandiser approves before anything is sent.

points.ontop: Works on top of email, WhatsApp, spreadsheets, ERP and portals. Nothing is replaced.
points.authority: Autonomy per stream. A person approves anything that commits money, stock or dates.
points.ledger: Every message and decision signed in a ledger a manager can review.
points.a2a: When a customer or supplier also runs VIA, the agents talk to each other.

request.title: Request access
request.intro: VIA Labs sets each company up by hand and runs the agents with you. Tell us who you are and we will be in touch.
request.name: Your name
request.message: What takes your merchandising team's time today?
request.sent: Thank you. We will reply by email within two working days.

video.title: One minute in the product
video.note: Sign in, ask the agent, approve, and see the ledger. Sample data; the company names are fictional.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your work email. We send an 8-digit sign-in code; type it here.
login.idle: You were signed out after 2 hours without activity.
login.ended: That session has ended. Sign in again.
login.noAccount: This email has no VIA Merch access yet. Ask your manager for an invite, or request access.
login.error: That code did not work. Each code works once and expires after an hour; request a new one.
login.link: That link was already used or has expired. Request a new code.

day.empty: Nothing waiting. New messages and slips produce drafts here on their own.
day.noOrders: No orders yet. Import a spreadsheet or connect a channel to begin.
day.agentToday: Agent today: {runs} runs · {msgs} messages in · USD {cost}
day.allCustomersNote: You see every customer and the whole team.
day.prepared: {name} has prepared {n, plural, =0 {nothing yet} =1 {1 draft} other {# drafts}}

queue.title: Approval queue
queue.sub: What the agents have drafted and may not send alone. Approve, edit, or reject; every decision is a signed ledger row.
queue.empty: Nothing waiting. Drafts appear here when a message arrives or when you ask the agent for one.
queue.approvedNote: Approved drafts go out when the channel is connected; until then VIA Labs sends them with you.

admin.title: VIA admin
admin.name: Name
admin.scopeHint: Hold Ctrl or Cmd to pick several. None selected = all customers.
admin.fromRequest: From the access request by {name} ({company}). Saving marks the request provisioned and links it to the company.

orders.title: Orders & T&A
orders.sub: The critical path is computed: a reported slip moves every milestone downstream. Click a PO for the record.
orders.legend: Green: done. Blue: due within 7 days. Amber: forecast later than plan. Red: late.
orders.pathNote: Plan dates come from the PO. Forecast moves when an upstream milestone slips by more than a day.
orders.importIntro: Upload the order list you already keep: an .xlsx, .xls or .csv with one row per PO. Customers and factories named in the file are created if they are new. Milestone plan dates are computed from the ETD unless the file gives them.
orders.importMilestones: Milestone dates, if you have them

parties.title: Customers & suppliers
parties.sub: Who the company makes for and buys from. Every order links to a customer and a supply chain: factory, mill, fibre.
parties.name: Name

connections.title: Connections
connections.sub: VIA works on the channels and systems you already use. Connect what your team uses today; everything else is a request away and a short build on our side.
connections.availableNote: What the agents read and send on
connections.wiredSoon: Connecting goes live with the channels build; VIA Labs connects it with you until then.
connections.catalogueNote: Every system below has a known route in. Ask for one and VIA Labs builds and tests the connector as part of your retainer.
connections.trademark: Product names and logos belong to their owners and are shown to identify the systems VIA connects to; they do not imply endorsement.

ledger.title: Ledger & autonomy
ledger.sub: Every action by a person or an agent, hash-chained and append-only. Autonomy is set per stream; locked streams are capped.
ledger.gateNote: L0 record only · L1 agent drafts, a person sends · L2 routine messages sent by the agent · L3 act within limits. Raising a level is itself logged. Managers and owners can change it.

agents.title: Agents
agents.sub: Agents work the record on their own: they read every inbound message, capture dates, queue replies and chasers, and wait for a person only where the gate says so.
agents.placeholder: e.g. What needs me today? / Chase Huaxin for the fabric date on 48812 / Draft a WIP note to Northline
agents.noKey: The agents need an Anthropic API key in the Vercel project (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Until it is set, this screen shows the agent and its tools but cannot run it.
agents.simulateSub: Before a channel is connected, paste a message as if it had arrived by email or WhatsApp. The pipeline logs it, links the party and PO, captures any reported date and queues a reply.
agents.subject: Subject
agents.name: Name
agents.autoTitle: What the agent does without being asked
agents.auto1: Reads every inbound message on a connected channel: language, English rendering, which customer, which PO.
agents.auto2: Records dates a supplier or customer states as fact and recomputes the critical path.
agents.auto3: Queues a reply to each message, in the sender’s language, at the stream’s autonomy level.
agents.auto4: Every hour: a recovery request for each exception and a chaser for each milestone due within 3 days that nobody has reported.
agents.auto5: Answers the team in the panel on every screen and drafts what they dictate.

assistant.title: Ask
assistant.placeholder: Ask about any PO, customer or supplier, or dictate a message
assistant.noKey: The agent is not switched on yet (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
assistant.s_orders: Which POs are off plan, and why?
assistant.s_order: Where is this PO against plan?
assistant.s_queue: Summarise what is waiting for me
assistant.s_ledger: What did the agent do today?
assistant.s_any1: Chase the factory for the fabric date
assistant.s_any2: Draft a WIP note to a customer

threads.title: Conversations
threads.sub: Every chain with a customer or supplier, grouped by order. The agent keeps a summary on each so nobody reads back through it.
threads.subject: Topic
threads.none: No conversations yet. They start when a channel is connected or a message arrives.
threads.noSummaryYet: The agent will summarise this once the key is set.
threads.awaitingChannel: approved, goes out when the channel is connected
threads.noConversations: No conversations on this order yet.
threads.pendingReply: Reply drafted by the agent, waiting for approval
